items.t: Venture Global Adds 0.5 MTPA To Long-Term China Gas Agreement
items.sum: Venture Global, Inc. on Tuesday expanded its existing agreement with China Gas Holdings through an amended Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA). The deal covers the supply of 1.0 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) over 20 years, beginning in 2030. The revised deal adds another 0.5 MTPA to the original 0.5 MTPA agreement announced by the companies in September 2026. W
